Hello, I believe I figured something.

There is a couple of combination of compilation arguments, that if used, will disable the creation of certain assets, but those assets are then used later on for unit tests, which promptly fail to load.

There is another additional problem, if you run in the CI the tests, or in your own computer, you can be luck for the test files to be saved into the cache from a completely unrelated build of Godot, and then the tests might run just fine everywhere.

`module_gdscript_enabled=no` is definitely a case, since the file `modules/gdscript/tests/scripts/project.godot` is under gdscript, the test that fails for @Calinou `./tests/core/config/test_project_settings.h:50` fails to run.
